purpose: Stage 0 of GROW_UP_ROOT_DOWN_REVISE_20261113: measure kernel K_v1 tool reliability on frozen training instances; engineering column only, no agent, no test split.
instance_note: All 8 frozen training instances of each template, listed before execution; no filtering by outcome. TP01 training cases were partly used in tp01_adaptive_dev_20261026_015 development.

baselines.negative: 2 s wait on the first instance of each template; any goal satisfaction invalidates the whole batch
baselines.engineering: fixed K_v1 tool chain (TP01: locate,grasp; TP03/TP04: locate,grasp,place)

prediction: TP01 full success 1-4/8 (point 2/8): only 1/2 development evidence for this cup/bottle recipe in this plant.
TP03 full success 0-2/8 (point 1/8): cup-to-tray never executed in this plant; placement offset leaf was tuned on the platter.
TP04 full success 0-3/8 (point 1/8): T03 near-side parent was 1/4 and these instances are not restricted to the near-side grid.
Most failures occur in the grasp tool, and at least 70% of all tool failures are detected by the tool itself.
falsification: Any template reaches 6/8 or more: the kernel is stronger than predicted.
More than half of tool failures are undetected: the kernel cannot support check-and-retry routines without new monitors.
Negative control satisfies a goal: the whole batch is invalid.
decision_rule: A tool is opened for a template's situation buckets when its boundary ok rate is at least 60% there; otherwise the bucket is narrowed or the user decides on an idealized tool. Thresholds are initial values, not validated settings.
